questions.prompt: What is the report mainly trying to establish?
options: How food retailers should replace their existing suppliers.
Why each local authority should design a separate food law.
Which national role could strengthen a system that retains local regulation.
How businesses should publish their own hygiene ratings.
questions.explanationZh: 报告比较全国层面角色如何与地方体系协同，并承认需进一步设计；不涉及企业自行发布评级等安排。

questions.prompt: Why does the Agency see a case for national oversight of large retailers?
options: Their local branches are described as the least compliant businesses.
Company-level decisions can affect consumers and suppliers across many areas.
Local authorities have requested the removal of all their food duties.
Their staff can provide the legal powers needed by local authorities.
questions.explanationZh: 即便分店合规，公司层面决策仍可产生跨地区影响，这才是报告的论证。

questions.prompt: How would Direct Assurance differ from the alternative framework?
options: Local authorities would remain the competent authority for the businesses concerned.
The Agency would stop collecting company-wide data and audit evidence.
Large businesses would select the local officers who inspect them.
Local food teams would regulate only businesses that volunteered.
questions.explanationZh: 直接保证评估保留地方主管机关职责，另一方案由该局直接监管大企业。

questions.prompt: What warning does the report give about local resources?
options: They should be transferred to businesses submitting the most data.
They should be replaced by the expected savings from consultation.
They should be reduced once either framework enters detailed design.
They should not be cut merely because national arrangements are created.
questions.explanationZh: 报告明确反对把设立全国安排当作削减地方资源的理由，大多数企业仍受地方监管。

questions.prompt: What can a reader conclude about the two recommended frameworks?
options: Their comparative effects on food safety have already been demonstrated.
Their practical feasibility still needs work despite their strategic appeal.
Their legal and staffing requirements are already fully funded.
Their adoption by different governments has already been agreed.
questions.explanationZh: 方案得到战略层面的推荐，但人员、资金、法律和数字系统问题仍待研究，不能推成已证明效果或已获各政府同意。
